# telnyx_advanced_number_orders (Data Source)

Lists advanced number orders, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_advanced_number_order`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `advanced_number_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_number_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--advanced_number_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_number_orders`

Read-Only:

- `area_code` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `customer_reference` (String)
- `features` (Set of String)
- `id` (String)
- `orders` (List of String)
- `phone_number_type` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `quantity` (Number)
- `requirement_group_id` (String) The ID of the requirement group associated with this advanced order
- `status` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
